svg.title: AgenteARQ: your AI writes the code, AgenteARQ makes it prove it
svg.desc: Pixel-art voxel islands show seven steps from idea to a reviewed pull request: discover, specify, plan, build, verify in a sandbox, independent review, and PR ready. A voxel robot stands for the AI coding assistant. Checks run sandboxed and fail closed, review cannot come from the author, and it works with Claude Code, Codex and Gemini CLI.
